description: Standardization rollup for cards common balance data grouped by product and currency.

test_cases.name: Schema Validation
test_cases.objective: Ensure the standardized dataset exposes exactly the expected columns.

test_cases.name: Aggregation Accuracy
test_cases.objective: Verify the summed txn_amt per (product_id, txn_ccy) matches the source feed.

test_cases.name: Group Uniqueness
test_cases.objective: Confirm each (product_id, txn_ccy) pair appears only once in the standardized output.

test_cases.name: Row Count Alignment
test_cases.objective: Check the number of rows equals the distinct (product_id, txn_ccy) combinations from the source.

test_cases.name: Total Amount Conservation
test_cases.objective: Validate that the grand total of txn_amt in the output equals the grand total from the source data.

test_cases.name: Null Safety
test_cases.objective: Ensure product_id, txn_ccy, and total_txn_amt contain no null values after aggregation.

test_cases.name: Boundary Condition Checks
test_cases.objective: Validate aggregated totals remain within configured numeric bounds.

test_cases.name: Edge Case Coverage
test_cases.objective: Confirm groups contributing minimum and maximum transaction amounts are preserved post-standardization.

test_cases.name: Happy Path Verification
test_cases.objective: Spot-check canonical product and currency combinations to ensure the pipeline produces trusted totals.

test_cases.name: Negative Scenario Guard
test_cases.objective: Detect negative or non-numeric totals that would signal upstream data quality issues.

test_cases.name: Regression Guardrails
test_cases.objective: Compare standardized output against historical benchmarks to catch regressions early.

test_cases.name: Volume and Load Resilience
test_cases.objective: Ensure the pipeline handles expected volume by verifying minimum record counts.

test_cases.name: Network Failure Resilience
test_cases.objective: Assert output artifacts are fully materialized with no truncated segments.

test_cases.name: Concurrency Idempotence
test_cases.objective: Verify output stability when re-aggregated to catch potential race conditions or duplicate writes.

test_cases.name: Infrastructure Footprint
test_cases.objective: Verify that required data and output directories exist and are accessible.

test_cases.name: Privacy Controls
test_cases.objective: Ensure the standardized output does not expose sensitive personally identifiable information.

test_cases.name: Security Compliance
test_cases.objective: Validate identifiers match expected formatting rules to mitigate injection or tampering risks.

test_cases.name: Vulnerability Scan
test_cases.objective: Surface non-finite or abnormally large totals that could signal overflow vulnerabilities or upstream corruption.
